title: AccountTransaction
description: Represents a single account transaction (e.g. checking_transactions, savings_transactions) exported to BigQuery for spending and cash flow analysis.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this transaction.

amount.description: The transaction amount. Negative values indicate expenses/outflows.

description.description: The raw description of the transaction from the bank statement.

raw_category.description: The category provided by the financial institution before normalization.

normalized_category.description: The category after normalization into our standard taxonomy.

account_type.description: The type of account (e.g. checking, savings).
